title: Cambium Moosh truth-tiered coverage model
principle: Every surface has exactly one UI evidence lane and one system evidence lane. UI evidence never proves connected-system behavior; request/response evidence never proves execution; projections never prove writes.
authority_rules: T0 reference and T1 observed cannot authorize capture, execution, deployment, or provider mutation.
T2 connected authorizes only the exact observed endpoint response, not the UI interpretation or downstream state.
T3 execution requires an admitted task, matching approval receipt, and terminal/rollback receipt.
No lane may upgrade itself by being rendered in a different shell.

L1-documentation.name: Documentation contract
L1-documentation.proves: a reviewed repository contract exists at the named source
L1-documentation.does_not_prove: runtime behavior, live deployment, UI rendering, or execution

L2-terminal.name: Local terminal verification
L2-terminal.proves: local tests, validators, or CLI contracts exited with the captured result
L2-terminal.does_not_prove: hosted, connected, deployed, or browser-rendered behavior
L2-terminal.probe: npm test / npm run validate / render-docs:check

L3-request-response.name: Live request/response evidence
L3-request-response.proves: the named HTTP endpoint returned the recorded status, headers, and bounded body
L3-request-response.does_not_prove: the UI that consumes the response, downstream writes, or semantic acceptance

L4-ui-screenshot.name: Captured UI evidence
L4-ui-screenshot.proves: the named surface rendered the captured pixels at the recorded viewport/time
L4-ui-screenshot.does_not_prove: the backend request succeeded, connected systems are live, or projection data is authoritative

L5-boundary-map.name: Boundary map only
L5-boundary-map.proves: the repository documents the connected system's ownership and handoff
L5-boundary-map.does_not_prove: the connected system is reachable, authenticated, or did anything

L6-video.name: Composed video evidence
L6-video.proves: accepted guide evidence was assembled into bounded motion
L6-video.does_not_prove: any underlying claim beyond its accepted guide evidence
L6-video.probe: FilmSpec + accepted guide evidence + video composition approval

L7-approval.name: Approval receipt
L7-approval.proves: an owner issued a matching, bounded approval
L7-approval.does_not_prove: the approved operation was requested, ran, or succeeded
L7-approval.probe: verify approval_id against the governing receipt

L8-request.name: Request-only evidence
L8-request.proves: a typed, idempotent request was submitted and acknowledged
L8-request.does_not_prove: workers, capture tools, providers, or runtime effects were launched
L8-request.probe: POST request + response envelope; no execution side effects

T0-reference.name: Reference / declared intent
T0-reference.authority: documentation, packet, plan, or projection only
T0-reference.cannot_authorize: capture, execution, deployment, provider mutation, operational writes
T0-reference.must_label: the source path/version and freshness timestamp

T1-observed.name: Observed local evidence
T1-observed.authority: locally verified contract, test, CLI, or local read model
T1-observed.cannot_authorize: hosted, connected, or authenticated runtime claims
T1-observed.must_label: exact command/output, route, or artifact hash

T2-connected.name: Connected request/response
T2-connected.can_authorize: a claim about that exact endpoint response
T2-connected.cannot_authorize: the UI interpretation of the response or downstream state
T2-connected.must_label: status, headers, bounded body, timestamp, credential boundary

T3-execution.name: Execution / write authority
T3-execution.authority: goal graph, D1, deployment, delivery, or provider write boundary
T3-execution.can_authorize: only the exact admitted operational action
T3-execution.cannot_authorize: a prior projection, plan, request, or UI state
T3-execution.must_label: admitted task, gate receipt, rollback/discard path, terminal receipt
